_comment: An example edit file. Nothing here applies yet: a name starting with _ is skipped, like a comment.
To use an edit, remove the _ from its table's name (e.g. _DT_EnemyCrafting -> DT_EnemyCrafting).
A file is {table: {row: {field: new value}}}, with tables, rows and fields as in the files alchemists-tools extract writes to data/.
Only the fields you give change; objects merge field by field, and lists are replaced whole.
Every edit file in edits/ is read, in alphabetical order. Delete this one when you're done with it.
docs/MODDING.md in the alchemists-tools repository (github.com/TobyTicehurst/alchemists-tools) has the rest: new recipes, buildings and research, and the checks the build makes.

WoodGear._comment: Processor: 1 Large Wooden Gear -> 4 Small Wooden Gears (was 3)

LargeWoodGear._comment: Grinder: 3 s per Large Wooden Gear (was 6 s)

WhisperingFields._comment: Brew Barrel: 20 Linseed Oil + 80 Fruit Wine (was 40 + 80); a list is given whole

FlaxSeed._comment: Nursery: Flax needs 12 V of fertilizer (was 24)

Main2._comment: The second main quest asks for 25 Linen Rope (was 50)
